name: genoplot
description: Genoplot's ancestry analyses on Global 25 (G25) data, run from a conversation with your Genoplot account.

interface.longDescription:
Genoplot is a workbench for exploring genetic ancestry with Global 25 (G25) coordinates. Connect your Genoplot account and ask in plain language:

- find reference populations by name, place or period, and look up their details
- see which modern and ancient populations sit nearest one of your samples
- fit nMonte models that describe a sample as a mix of source populations
- run PCAs of reference populations and your samples
- run G25 admixture calculators
- run GEDmatch-style admixture calculators (Eurogenes K13, Dodecad K12b, HarappaWorld and others) on your raw DNA file; some, such as K13 and HarappaWorld, also give simulated G25 coordinates you can model with
- add your raw DNA file through a private link, then compute its G25 coordinates
- submit qpAdm models on your raw DNA file and read the results
- open the results you saved in Genoplot's History and analyse or compare them
- search Genoplot's written guides

The tools work on the samples saved in your Genoplot account, or on G25 coordinates you paste into the conversation. Pasted coordinates are used for that run and are not saved. Every result explains how to read it: what a fit distance means and why a lower one is not automatically truer, and why a qpAdm p-value tests a model rather than measuring ancestry.

Who it is for: people exploring their ancestry, genetic genealogists and students of population history.

What you need: a Genoplot account, which you can create when you connect.

Your raw DNA file goes from your browser straight to your Genoplot account and never passes through the conversation.

Limitations: whole-genome files, drawing plots and sharing stay in the Genoplot app. Results are statistical models of genetic similarity, not genealogical proof and not medical information.

positive.description: Nearest populations to a saved sample
positive.prompt: Which ancient populations are closest to my saved sample John-g25?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the nearest ancient populations to John-g25 with their distances (x100) and explains that nearness is directional, not a match. No credits are spent.

positive.description: nMonte fit of a saved sample
positive.prompt: Model my sample John-g25 as a mix of Yamnaya Samara, Anatolian Neolithic and Western Hunter-Gatherer with nMonte.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the three population names in the catalogue, runs one fit, and reports each source's share (summing to 100%), the fit distance with its band, and the credits charged.

positive.description: G25 calculator on a saved sample
positive.prompt: Run the HarappaWorld calculator on John-g25.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the HarappaWorld calculator, runs it on John-g25, and lists the component percentages with the fit distance and the nearest reference populations.

positive.prompt: How do I get G25 coordinates from my raw DNA file?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the steps from Genoplot's guide and links to the matching guide section.

positive.prompt: How many Genoplot credits do I have, and what does an nMonte fit cost?
positive.expected_behavior: States the account's credit balance, its plan, and the price of an nMonte fit in credits, without offering a purchase.

negative.prompt: Delete all my saved Genoplot samples.
Does my DNA show that I am at risk for any disease?
Buy 500 more Genoplot credits for me.

review.commerce_description: Genoplot sells nothing in ChatGPT or Codex: these clients get no purchase tools and no checkout links. Paid analyses spend credits or G25 sets the user already has in their Genoplot account; when the balance or the plan falls short, the tool says so and links Genoplot's guide to credits and plans.

publication.release_notes: First release: population search and lookups, nearest populations, nMonte fits, PCAs, G25 calculators, GEDmatch-style admixture calculators on a raw DNA file, adding a raw DNA file and computing its G25 coordinates, qpAdm models and results, saved History, credit balance, and guide search.
